projects.title: MAK Studio
projects.subtitle: Fabrication, prototyping & built work
projects.summary: Studio photographs and presentation boards documenting making, material execution and detailed design. Original credit and project-by-project roles should be confirmed.
projects.competitionFit: Strong fabrication and buildability evidence for public-art commissions.
projects.review: Studio attribution visible in the image filenames; individual project names and precise contributions require review.

projects.title: Lotus Flower
projects.subtitle: Public art & sculptural exploration
projects.summary: Lotus Flower photographs and related TADAEX archive images, grouped as a sculptural-art series. Exact exhibition titles, image rights and collaborators should be verified.
projects.competitionFit: Relevant to sculptural concepts and site-responsive public-art proposals.
projects.review: Grouped from Lotus and TADA image filenames; confirm they refer to the same work before final publication.

projects.title: DesignHive / Inventure
projects.subtitle: Spatial and interior fabrication
projects.summary: A documented set of Inventure and work-area images from DesignHive, including built interior and spatial-component studies.
projects.competitionFit: Useful evidence of human-scale spatial experience and detailing.
projects.review: Confirm scope, collaborators and contribution credits.

projects.title: Fabrication & Site Documentation
projects.subtitle: Workshop and construction photo series
projects.summary: A chronological collection of site and workshop photographs from 2018. These images are kept together pending project identification instead of being attributed to an unverified client.
projects.competitionFit: Potentially strong evidence of fabrication experience, logistics and physical installation.
projects.review: Project identity and individual photo attribution must be confirmed before use in a competition application.

projects.title: Final Design Presentation
projects.subtitle: Architectural proposal boards
projects.summary: A cohesive archive of drawings, renderings and presentation boards saved as FINAL_Page images.
projects.competitionFit: Supports concept development and ability to communicate an integrated proposal.
projects.review: Final project title and authorship need confirmation.

projects.title: Architecture: Form & Diagrams
projects.subtitle: Renderings, sections and spatial concepts
projects.summary: A group of perspective views, sections, diagrams and main renderings. Kept separate from other projects where source filenames do not establish a title.
projects.competitionFit: Evidence of visual storytelling and concept-to-design exploration.
projects.review: Verify that these images belong to one project.

projects.title: PVAMU Presentation
projects.subtitle: Design presentation series
projects.summary: Presentation slides labeled PVAMU, organized together as one historical set.
projects.competitionFit: Demonstrates professional or academic design communication.
projects.review: Confirm event, project and collaborator credits.

projects.title: Design Presentation Archive
projects.subtitle: Earlier conceptual design boards
projects.summary: Numbered Presentation_Page slides preserved as a single presentation set.
projects.competitionFit: Additional proposals, visual studies and design process.
projects.review: Project identity not established by filenames.

projects.title: Interior Visualizations
projects.subtitle: Living room studies
projects.summary: Living room renderings from the earlier portfolio.
projects.competitionFit: Secondary evidence of spatial design and visualization.

projects.title: Computational & Generative Research
projects.subtitle: Algorithms, form and art studies
projects.summary: Computational-design images, pixel-algorithm experiments and generative visual studies.
projects.competitionFit: Supports the studio's algorithmic design and digital-art research.
projects.review: Selected assets may be AI-generated illustrations and should be labeled accordingly.

projects.title: Unidentified Archive
projects.subtitle: Additional photographs to classify
projects.summary: Remaining photos whose filenames do not reliably establish a project. Preserved in the archive rather than assigned to a guessed commission.
projects.competitionFit: Not highlighted for juries until reviewed.
projects.review: Requires project-level identification and suitable publication rights.
